summary: Every legal input contains exactly three side lengths, so sorting and classifying it performs a fixed amount of work and no scalable workload dimension exists.

workload_bound.source_constraint: nums always contains exactly three integers from 1 through 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference sorts exactly three values and then performs a constant number of additions, comparisons, and returns.
The certificate regression checks all 100^3 ordered legal arrays against an independent triangle-inequality and equality oracle.
